title: Menger's theorem, vertex form for digraphs
statement: Let $D$ be a finite digraph and let $x$ and $y$ be two vertices of $D$ with no arc from $x$ to $y$. Then the maximum number of pairwise internally-disjoint directed paths from $x$ to $y$ equals the minimum number of vertices (other than $x$ and $y$) whose deletion destroys every directed path from $x$ to $y$.
hypotheses_covered: x and y are vertices of D
there is no arc from x to y
